about: The corrected table of the unit tube's image system (MIME-ANO-117), built 2026-10-29 from the defect-free series under one truncation for every source radius (2500 modes, 16000 Gauss nodes, k_max 3000), readable from the axis to 0.997 of the radius: the table the tube's wall kind reads. The same table at the earlier truncation (1667 modes) is kept beside it as the record, superseded (its reciprocity misses 2.0e-7 at the wall's edge knots) and read by nothing.
